title: Network Infrastructure Engineer
org: Jalsa Salana UK · Ahmadiyya Muslim Association UK · Volunteer
summary: Each summer I join the volunteer engineering team that builds and runs the network for a large multi-site event. It has to be ready by a fixed date, and it has to hold up for more than 2,000 people at once.
points: Wrote Linux scripts that monitor the hardware for us, so faults get flagged early instead of being found by attendees.
Helped keep the network at 99.9% uptime each year with 2,000+ concurrent users on it.
Configured hardware and ran structured cabling across the site, against a deadline that doesn't move.
Tracked down and fixed faults live, under time pressure, while people were relying on the connection.
Worked as part of a cross-functional engineering team on Docker and Linux-based systems.

title: Optical Assistant
summary: A customer-facing job alongside my final year. Not a tech role, but it made me careful with data and clear with people.
points: Handled sensitive patient records in a busy clinical setting and kept them 100% accurate.
Talked customers through their eyewear options and completed sales, matching the recommendation to what each person actually needed.
